Eamon's debut single, "Fuck It (I Don't Want You Back) "Fuck It (I Don't Want You Back)")" immediately caught the attention of urban, rhythmic, pop radio stations when it was released in the US in late 2003. The single reached the top 20 of the *Billboard* Hot 100, and the popularity of the song helped his album, *I Don't Want You Back*, debut in the top ten of the *Billboard* 200. In the latter country, "Fuck It (I Don't Want You Back)" remained at the summit of the UK Singles Chart for four weeks and became Britain's second best-selling song of 2004.
